method: Lossless 2x2 repeat and half-width/half-height wrap offset; compare seam MAE against every interior boundary. Numeric screen: each wrap MAE <= max(2x interior median, interior p99). Visual inspection is still required; this screen cannot prove grain continuity or absence of large-scale repetition.
visual_review: Inspected full original plus final 512 px half-wrap offset and 1024 px 2x2 repeat. Plain moss/olive weave with restrained slub and continuous overall tone. No conspicuous hard seam at delivery scale; numeric LR/TB ratios 1.161/0.937 are within normal texture variation. Yarn pattern repeats and physical yarn size remains an artistic scale assumption. Not proof of seamlessness at arbitrary magnification.
